payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_task.py::test_ready_task_rebuilds_an_orphaned_task_whose_cell_went_green stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/task.py. The claim was "`task.ready_task`, the rebuild `saffron package` runs, rebuilds an `ORPHANED` task whose cell recorded a `REVIEWING` turn and whose review reported no blocker and no errored lens. The `ReadyTask` it returns equals the one the same task rebuilds to once its row reads `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, so its outcome's state is `READY_FOR_REVIEW`. The rebuild writes no `tasks` row. The witness drives one such task whose review carries one anchored concern.", and the whole `tests` gate stayed green under the edit too.
